subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses correct punctuation (. , ? !); spells common words correctly and attempts unfamiliar words using phonics

show.line: Wow! Stop! Help! When we shout or feel strongly, we use an exclamation mark. A line with a dot!

rounds.prompt: Which mark is the exclamation mark?
rounds.praise: Yes! A line with a dot under it.

rounds.prompt: Watch out, a snake! Which mark goes at the end?
rounds.praise: Yes! We shout it, so an exclamation mark.

rounds.prompt: Read this with a big, excited voice.
Is it a question or a shout? What time is it?
rounds.praise: A question! It asks, so a question mark.

rounds.prompt: A list needs commas. I like apples, pears and grapes. Which card has the commas in the right place?
rounds.praise: Yes! A comma between the things in the list.

rounds.prompt: Full stop, question mark or exclamation mark? Put each sentence in its group.

hints: Would you shout it? Then it needs an exclamation mark.
Does it ask? Question mark. Does it tell? Full stop.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will finish this sentence. Happy birthday
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I put a question mark. Happy birthday?
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! We shout happy birthday. It needs an exclamation mark.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together with a big voice. Happy birthday! Exclamation mark!

parent_line: Knows when to use an exclamation mark and a comma in a list.
